# duploai_scope (Resource)

Manages a DuploCloud AI scope: a credentialed view over a provider's resources, filtered by AWS, Kubernetes, and Git rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A scope over an AWS provider credential, filtered to specific resources.
resource "duploai_scope" "aws" {
  name            = "prod-aws-readonly"
  description     = "Read-only view of production AWS resources"
  provider_id     = "<provider-id>"
  credential_name = "prod-aws"

  aws_resource_search_filter = {
    region               = "us-east-1"
    resource_types_regex = ["AWS::EC2::.*", "AWS::RDS::.*"]
    tags = [
      { key = "env", value = "prod" }
    ]
  }

  metadata = {
    team = "platform"
  }
}

# A scope backed by an MCP server (no credential_name needed).
resource "duploai_scope" "k8s" {
  name          = "cluster-view"
  mcp_server_id = "<mcp-server-id>"
  provider_id   = "<provider-id>"

  kubernetes_filter_config = {
    namespace_regex           = ["^app-.*"]
    namespaced_resource_types = ["deployments", "services"]
    cluster_resource_types    = ["nodes"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the scope. Immutable once created.

### Optional

- `aws_resource_search_filter` (Attributes) Optional filter restricting which AWS resources this scope can see. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws_resource_search_filter))
- `credential_name` (String) Name of the credential (on the referenced provider) this scope uses. Either credential_name or mcp_server_id must be set.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the scope.
- `git_resource_filter` (Attributes) Optional filter restricting which Git resources this scope can see. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git_resource_filter))
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the scope is active. Defaults to true.
- `kubernetes_filter_config` (Attributes) Optional filter restricting which Kubernetes resources this scope can see. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kubernetes_filter_config))
- `mcp_server_id` (String) ID of the MCP server backing this scope. Either credential_name or mcp_server_id must be set.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value metadata attached to the scope.
- `provider_id` (String) ID of the provider this scope is bound to. Required when mcp_server_id is set (the MCP server's provider type must match).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the scope was created.
- `id` (String) Composite resource identifier (workspace_id/id).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the scope was last updated.
- `version` (Number) Server-incremented version of the scope.

<a id="nestedatt--aws_resource_search_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws_resource_search_filter`

Optional:

- `region` (String) AWS region to scope resources to.
- `resource_types_regex` (List of String) Regular expressions matching AWS resource types to include.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tag key/value pairs resources must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws_resource_search_filter--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--aws_resource_search_filter--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws_resource_search_filter.tags`

Required:

- `key` (String) Tag key.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Tag value.



<a id="nestedatt--git_resource_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git_resource_filter`

Optional:

- `branches_regex` (List of String) Regular expressions matching branches to include.
- `repositories_regex` (List of String) Regular expressions matching repositories to include.


<a id="nestedatt--kubernetes_filter_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kubernetes_filter_config`

Optional:

- `cluster_resource_types` (List of String) Cluster-scoped resource types to include (e.g. nodes, persistentvolumes).
- `namespace_regex` (List of String) Regular expressions matching namespaces to include.
- `namespaced_resource_types` (List of String) Namespaced resource types to include (e.g. deployments, services).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing scope.
#  - SCOPE_ID is the unique identifier of the scope (e.g. 6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e)
terraform import duploai_scope.myscope SCOPE_ID
# Example:
# terraform import duploai_scope.myscope 6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e
```
